name: Alesya: Pobeg iz lagerya
source:
Through a harsh twist of fate, the protagonist ends up where he least expected to be - in Sovyonok, with no magic or teleportation involved. Everything remains in its place, only instead of Semyon, who is also present here, the focus is on a completely different person: a chronic loser, an ever-optimistic guy, an intellectual by nature, and a rebel inside. There, he meets the familiar residents and a new pioneer girl, Alesya.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1498012318]Steam[/url]]
